VERIFY: ID-HYDROPLANING-SPEED-WORDING — The same page says maintain a steady speed and then slowly release the accelerator when approaching a slippery area or hydroplaning. The supported straight-line, gradual-release and no-sudden-stop/turn instructions are retained; the intended relation to steady speed needs clarification before teaching a combined speed prescription.
VERIFY: ID-ICE-EXPLANATION-SPAN — The bridge and shade icing explanation spans physical pages one hundred thirteen and one hundred fourteen. The local caution about those locations is covered; the complete causal explanation needs a multi-page binding.
VERIFY: ID-STUDDED-TIRE-CURRENT-DATES — The printed October-through-April studded-tire interval on physical page one hundred fourteen explicitly permits department weather adjustments. No adjustment for the current season has been checked; the printed default must not be presented as verified current-season permission.
VERIFY: ID-FLOOD-GROWTH-EXAMPLE — The illustrative stream-width, depth and growth-time values on physical page one hundred twelve lack the conditions needed for a predictive model. They are withheld; no water depth is represented as safe to cross.
